posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Chrono Ranger, Greatest Legacy, Omnitron-X, Freedom 6 Bunker and Freedom 6 Unity vs. La Capitán in the Time Cataclysm.

 

This is another damage fest, and you can take down Maria (Helena Tereas etc.) pretty quicky if you concentrate damage on the ship, then her.  I went in blind and got a Mint without too much worry.

 

The Environment is kind of nice to you here, and I suggest you let the deck play as many cards as possible.  I made sure to take out The Amazing Mable, but I left Trueshot in play for the whole game as there was not much point in getting rid of her.  Make sure you take out the ship quickly to slow down her plays, and then pile damage onto the captain.

I had Omnitron-X playing Unity's cards for her, which was quite useful, especially with Greatest Legacy giving him 2 chances of freee bots per round.  Bunker's shuffle is pretty poor, so I suggest using Auxilliary Power Source in the first round to speed his deck up a bit.

The captain did flip once for me, as she plays an early Plunder that can take out a few cards, but Chrono Ranger can easily get rid of all her armour if he's played Displaced Armory to get his hat into play beforehand.

 

Overall, I found this one to be very fun.  Not too difficult, and it's nice to have a mostly friendly environment to play with.

posts.name: Kratos13
posts.cooked:
Mint as well.  I've had bad games against Le Capitan, so I took a more cautious approach.  

No Executions on the Ship (to safeguard against All Together Now)

Unity's first Flash Forge was a Construction Pylon and Volatile Parts (since many things with Le Capitan target lowest HP target).

Mable was down in Round One, Shopping Trip took down the Ship in Round Two, I took out Trueshot in Round 3.

Legacy and Omnitron-X concentrated on Unity who eventually got Swift, 3 Raptors, Cryo and Champion Bot out.

Le Capitan ended up playing lots of Walk the Planks.  Raiding Party brought out Chip, Final Breath, Siege Breaker and Battle Forged who killed a bot and brought out L'Epeiste but at that point the heroes were strong enough to deal with them quickly.

Le Capitan went down in Round 6.

Fun game and glad Le Capitan was not at her worst.

Mint. 

Chrono-Ranger put out early contracts on Mable and the ship to get rid of them both. Legacy helped with Inspiring Presence. posts.name: robb8888
posts.cooked:
Mint, with no hero under 20 HP.  Got lucky on the villain draws -- El Capitan was only able to get out three crew members (Trueshot, Mable, Chip), and never had more than two out at once.  The "reduce all damage by 1" and "reduce all HP recovery by 2" environment cards (I can't remember their names) hurt El Capitan much more than they hurt me.  

 

Between Grandpa Legacy and Omnitron-X, CR and Unity each got an extra free draw/play each round.  By Round 3, Unity had a couple of bots, Jim was wearing his Hat, and had three bounties out (By Any Means and Ultimate Target on El Capitan) and Hunter/Hunted to add to Grandpa Legacy's Inspiring Presence, so he was doing 12-14 per shot to El Capitan with the Compounded Bow.

 

At the beginning of Round 4, two Terrible Tech-Strikes (27 pts each) plus the Compounded Bow (another 12) sent El Capitan screaming back to the astral plane.

 

Bunker....sat and watched.

 

(Post-Script:  Played it again, and largely the same results -- only saw Trueshot, Mable, and Chip.  Grandpa Legacy took a bit more damage (self-inflicted from Heroic Interceptions), and this time El Capitan got shot (Turret Bot+Champion+Inspiring Presence), zapped (Platform Bot+CB+IP) and chomped to death by two Raptor Bots (6 bots out plus all the above).  This time Bunker.....also sat and watched.)

Huh. I had a much harder go of it than many of you. La Capitan had her whole crew out multiple times, wiped all of my stuff early and often, and I spent a lot of time getting her to flip back after she flipped.

 

 A couple of Heroic Interceptions saved the team during bad times. Legacy giving Chrono-Ranger attacks and O-X time-shifting Unity were the MVPs. Unity eventually overwhelmed La Capitan, though it took Stealth Bot protecting Swift Bot and regular Inspired Repairs on Swift Bot to really get Unity going.

 

Kicking for myself for not thinking of having Legacy give a power usage to O-X, to timeshift Unity twice each round.

posts.name: JimmyTheCannon
posts.cooked:
This was perhaps the easiest One-Shot (for me) that I've ever played. I mostly used Legacy > Omni-X > Timeshift Unity (I tried timeshifting Chrono-Ranger twice and got a Terrible Tech-Strike and a Sudden Contract while both damage bounties were already out, and while it wasn't a terrible play it seemed using it on Unity was better). Didn't get a single piece of equipment out for Chrono-Ranger, but between Inspiring Presence and his two damage increasing bounties he was still doing 4 damage a pop with Quick Shot.

Did a first-turn Heroic Interception, which allowed Unity to get two bots out without taking any damage. When Surprise Shopping Trip came out I used Legacy > Unity to get Stealth Bot out, which made it a fantastic shopping trip - between that and the Heroic, I took very little damage from that.

Only crew I saw were Mabel, Trueshot, and Final Breath. Mabel died (By Any Means, Chrono-Ranger, and Disruptive Flechettes) first  round and got shuffled back into the deck by the ship, which died second round (Chrono, Shopping Trip, Unity bots); Final Breath died to the shopping trip and the smaller hit on a Tech Strike and Trueshot died to Unity's bots. Of course, they both came back very quickly due to A Motley Crew, at which point I just ignored them and focused La Capitan.

Bunker mostly just used Gatling Gun after using Auxiliary Power Supply to get some cards to feed to it (and modes for his power), and took out the couple of ongoings La Capitan managed to play (Maria Helena's Revenge, would have done the same with Captain's Orders but she died between playing it and Bunker's turn). La Capitan dned up dying with only one card underneath her, to Omni-X's Singularity blowing up everyone else's equipment. Was it necessary? Nah, Bunker's Gatling Gun would have taken her out. But it was fun.

 

Went ahead and did last week's afterwards since it was so quick, and ended up clearing it in one attempt with a single rewind. Same theme - deal as much damage as possible as quickly as possible.
